name: Hyper Monks 3
summary: Hyper Monks 3 is an immersive VR game that transports you to an underground Japanese metropolis set in the future. Play as a monkey navigating the vibrant and bustling world of HyperCity, a futuristic city inspired by Tokyo. Experience a variety of activities, from riding the metro transit to exploring the neon-lit streets, shopping in the expansive mall, or playing games in the lively arcade. When hunger strikes, indulge in delectable cuisine at local eateries like the Sushi Shop, Ramen Shop, and cozy cafe
